title: Taṇhakkhaya
text: 1. Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || 2. Tatra kho āyasmā Anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi || || pe || || 3. Cattāro me āvuso satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkata taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattanti || katame cattāro || || 4. Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || pe [pa] || vedanāsu || citte || dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Ime kho āvuso cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhākkhayāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
